featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie made a point enterprise teams should internalize: nearly all AI model and agent progress is downstream from evals. Domain-specific open-weights post-training comes down to evals; applied-layer agent improvements are about evals; agentic enterprise deployments that actually augment work are all evals. He argues that understanding your own (and your customers') workflows—and how well agents participate in them—will become a core competency of every enterprise, and whoever does this best will be p…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 这周抛出一个挺值得 enterprise 团队记住的判断：AI 模型和 agent 的几乎所有进步，本质上都是 evals（评估体系）的下游产物。针对特定领域的开放权重后训练，落到最后是 evals；应用层的 agent 改进，是 evals；能真正增益工作的 agentic 企业部署，还是 evals——「一切都是 evals」。他认为，理解自己（以及客户）工作流、并衡量 agent 在其中参与得有多好，会成为未来每家企业的核心能力，谁掌握得最好，谁就最有资格驱动真正的自动化。同时 Box 上线了 HTML 内容的预览、编辑、版本管理与安全分享，专门为「直接处理任何 agent 产出的内容」而做。

featured.title: Swyx · Latent Space / Cognition
featured.summaryEn: Swyx laid out an underappreciated "compute + model lab" math: he thinks nobody is correctly calculating how SpaceX, as a NeoCloud + NeoLab, is going to market. By his account, SpaceX has already recouped roughly half its Cursor investment through compute deals, with the other half covered if Composer 3 does well. No other company is simultaneously a leading model lab and a neocloud (at least on GPUs). He calls it a crazy effective combo—provided you've adequately planned GPU supply so that it holds whether in-hous…
featured.insightZh: Swyx 给了一个被市场低估的「算力 + 模型实验室」组合账：他认为没人在正确计算 SpaceX 作为「NeoCloud + NeoLab」当前的市场打法。按他的说法，SpaceX 已经通过算力交易回收了对 Cursor 投资的约一半成本，另一半如果 Composer 3 表现好就能覆盖。没有任何其他公司同时是领先的模型实验室 + neocloud（至少在 GPU 维度上）。他强调这是个极其高效的组合——前提是你已经把 GPU 供给规划好：无论自研训练「跑得非常好」还是「跑得不太好」，这套打法都能兜住。

featured.title: How Anthropic Uses Claude Fable 5 With Mike Krieger
featured.summaryEn: When a model gets powerful enough, the bottleneck is no longer model capability but your old habits of decomposing tasks and expressing intent—you have to relearn how to use it like a newbie. Mike Krieger, Instagram cofounder and now head of Anthropic Labs, talked through his lived, day-in-day-out experience with this model generation the night before Fable 5 dropped. His strongest takeaway: he feels like a total newbie again. Not because the model is hard to use—the opposite—but because his old prompting style of breaking tasks into fine steps and feeding them one by one is now out of date. Early on he'd say "I have an idea for this feature, can we start with X," and the model would say "absolutely not." The better approach now is to express more intent, let the model understand where you're evolving toward and grasp the global context, then one-shot it. He shared a personal example: o…
featured.insightZh: 当模型强到一定程度，瓶颈不再是模型能力，而是你「分解任务、表达意图」的旧习惯——你得像新手一样重学怎么用它。 Mike Krieger，Instagram 联合创始人、现 Anthropic Labs 负责人，在新模型 Fable 5 发布前夜聊了他「日复一日」使用这代模型的真实体感。他最强烈的感受是：自己又像个彻头彻尾的新手。原因不是模型不好用，恰恰相反——是他过去那套「把任务拆细、一步步喂给模型」的提示方式，对这代模型已经过时了。早期他会「我有个 feature 想法，能不能先从 X 开始」，模型会说「完全不必」；现在更对的方式是「表达更多意图」，让模型理解你要往哪演进、理解全局上下文，然后一次成型。 他举了个亲身案例：一个周末，他在陪孩子徒步的间隙，用 Claude 做了一个「能从软件内部修改软件自身」的 spike——长按聊天框就能提出编辑请求，用 Anthropic 的 managed agents 接管、预览 diff、用 Vercel live preview 实时看效果，整个 feature 几乎是 one-shot 出来的，之后随手在手机上迭代（「浮动按钮在 iOS 上太低了，帮我调一下」，它就调了）。他坦言并不在意这种软件的代码质量或长期可维护性——重点是「想法到可用产品」的链路被极致压缩了。 他把这和 Instagram 时代做对比：当年他自认是高产程序员，但「从想法到完整产品」仍要四五天的通宵，前后端一个人扛，Kevin 做滤镜。更关键的是发布后——他们有一堆想法却被「先把网站撑住、加一个增量 feature」卡死，hashtags 要做一周。现在变化是双重的：想法到原型的时间被压缩，且你能持续在已有基础上迭代。成本曲线的剧烈下降，让「自我修改的 agent native 架构」这种十年前要专门组队才敢碰的东西，变成了一个周末的玩物。

items.title: Sam Altman & Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenAI ran a "Patch The Planet" theme this week—moving security from merely finding vulnerabilities to actually solving them. Sam Altman announced the full GPT-5.5-Cyber with state-of-the-art performance on CyberGym, saying they want to help all companies be secure by working with the USG and the security ecosystem; Codex Security and Patch The Planet aim to fix security problems instead of just surfacing them. OpenAI's Codex/ChatGPT lead Thibault Sottiaux pushed companion Codex security updates, calling it a day…
items.insightZh: OpenAI 这周打出「Patch The Planet」主题——把安全从「只会找漏洞」推进到「真正解决问题」。Sam Altman 宣布完整版 GPT-5.5-Cyber 上线，在 CyberGym 上达到 SOTA 性能，并表示希望联合美国政府和安全生态帮助所有公司变得更安全；Codex Security 和 Patch The Planet 的定位是去修复而非仅仅发现安全问题。OpenAI 的 Codex/ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 同步推送了 Codex 安全更新，把这一天称为「网络防御加速的庆祝日」。对企业安全团队来说，这是值得关注的能力转向：从扫描发现转向自动修补。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shipped two concrete capabilities this week. First, "Claude Design → Vercel in one click"—pushing Claude-generated designs straight to Vercel, further collapsing the design-to-production path. Second, Vercel now natively supports WebSocket (and socket.io), spanning from CDN to Fluid, which he called a special full-circle moment. For teams building real-time apps or agent interaction surfaces, this means no longer routing long-lived connections through external infrastructure.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 这周连发两个落地能力。一是「Claude Design → Vercel，一键部署」——把 Claude 生成的设计直接一键推到 Vercel，进一步压缩从设计到上线的链路。二是 Vercel 现在原生支持 WebSocket（以及 socket.io），覆盖从 CDN 到 Fluid 的完整路径，他称之为「特别的圆满时刻」。对做实时应用、agent 交互界面的团队来说，这意味着不再需要为长连接绕一圈外部基础设施。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang shared a candid gripe worth noting for anyone teaching Claude Code tooling: he read through the material on "dynamic workflows" and still doesn't get what a dynamic workflow actually is or when to use it in Claude Code. It's a high-signal piece of feedback—if a creator with 150K+ readers finds the concept poorly communicated, the naming and docs around agent orchestration still have a lot of room to improve. For teams writing agent product docs, it's a reminder: products whose jargon outpaces intuition…
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 坦诚地吐了个槽，值得做 Claude Code 工具教学的人留意：他读完了关于「dynamic workflow（动态工作流）」的材料，仍然没搞懂动态工作流到底是什么、什么时候该在 Claude Code 里用它。这是一个很有信号价值的反馈——连 150K+ 读者的 AI 教程创作者都觉得这个概念表达不清，说明 agent 编排领域的概念命名和文档还有很大改进空间。对正在做 agent 产品文档的团队，这是一记提醒：术语先于直觉的产品，门槛会偷偷变高。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人
items.summaryEn: Cursor design lead Ryo Lu gave a talk at Cursor Compile on how we build in the age of AI—and what doesn't change. He framed it around invariants: in an environment where model capabilities iterate rapidly, which principles of building products stay constant regardless of AI. For product and design teams swept up in the AI wave and rethinking workflows weekly, the "find the invariants first" framing offers a stabilizing anchor. The full talk is on YouTube.
items.insightZh: Cursor 设计负责人 Ryo Lu 在 Cursor Compile 大会上做了一场分享，主题是「在 AI 时代我们如何构建产品，以及什么是不变的」。他把视角放在「不变量」上——在模型能力快速迭代的环境里，哪些构建产品的原则不会因为 AI 而改变。对正在被 AI 浪潮裹挟、每周都要重新思考工作流的产品/设计团队来说，这种「先找不变量」的思路是一种稳定锚点。完整演讲已发到 YouTube。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、Frontend Slides skill 作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang, who maintains this Follow Builders feed, released a complete walkthrough of her Frontend Slides skill (22k+ stars on GitHub). The 11-minute video covers: creating beautiful HTML slides with Claude Code (beginner friendly), how she built the skill, how you can create your own, plus practical tips like inserting images/videos into a deck and publishing. For anyone trying to understand the "skill-ification" paradigm—packaging reusable capabilities for an agent—it's a solid starting point.
items.insightZh: Follow Builders 这条 feed 的维护者 Zara Zhang 发布了一份完整教程，讲她那个在 GitHub 上拿到 22k+ stars 的 Frontend Slides skill。这份 11 分钟视频覆盖：如何用 Claude Code 创建漂亮的 HTML 幻灯片（新手友好）、她是怎么把这个能力做成 skill 的、你如何创建自己的 skill，以及一些实操技巧——比如怎么往 deck 里插图片/视频、怎么发布。对想理解「skill 化」这种把可复用能力封装给 agent 的范式的人，这是一份很好的上手材料。
